risks.risk: Page count may be higher than stated (affects wear and value).
risks.proof: A clear photo/screenshot of the printer’s page counter/usage report (e.g., total prints and colour pages) from the device menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear/unknown usage (worst case vs the claim).

risks.risk: “New drum and toner” may be untrue or may be low-quality/incorrect parts; could cause poor print quality or short life.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the toner/drum cartridges installed (part numbers/labels) plus a print test page showing colour quality.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed fresh consumables (worst case: treat as used/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Paper jam may recur due to feed rollers, sensors, or fuser/transfer issues not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A short video clip of a full print run (e.g., 10–20 pages) showing no jam and normal feeding from the tray.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential reliability issues (worst case: treat as not confirmed jam-free).

risks.risk: Exact model is unclear; performance and parts compatibility vary widely across HP colour MFPs.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial label (sticker) on the unit or the “About/Device information” screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price using the closest comparable category (HP colour laser MFP/colour laser) at worst-case assumptions.

Clear photo of the model/serial label or “Device information/About” screen.
